guides.title: 原理、算例與驗證：原子力顯微鏡
guides.titleEn: Principles, examples and verification: Atomic force microscopes
guides.concept: 以懸臂為奈牛頓等級的力感測器出發，理解 AFM 如何用光槓桿把皮米偏折放大成可量測的訊號，再把懸臂製作、共振模式、彈簧常數校正、熱雜訊、閉迴路掃描與標準樣品驗收整合成可交接的表面計量工程。
guides.conceptEn: Start from the cantilever as a nanonewton force sensor to see how an AFM amplifies picometre deflections into measurable signals with an optical lever, then integrate cantilever fabrication, resonance modes, spring-constant calibration, thermal noise, closed-loop scanning and reference-sample acceptance into a transferable surface-metrology record.
procedure: 原子力顯微鏡不需要導電樣品，它把一支末端帶尖銳探針的微懸臂靠近表面，由探針與表面之間的作用力使懸臂彎曲。遠距離時以凡得瓦吸引力與靜電力為主，接觸後以泡利排斥與彈性變形為主，液體中還有毛細力與雙電層力。懸臂依虎克定律 F = k·Δz 把力轉成偏折，彈簧常數從 0.01 N/m 的軟懸臂到 40 N/m 的硬懸臂，對應可量測的力從 pN 到 µN。成像時回授系統維持偏折（接觸模式）或振幅、頻率（動態模式）為定值，Z 軸的回授輸出即為地形。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「懸臂—探針—表面作用力」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

動態模式讓懸臂在共振頻率附近振動，探針只在每個週期最低點短暫接觸或完全不接觸表面，橫向力幾乎為零。小振幅時作用力梯度 ∂F/∂z 會改變有效彈簧常數，使共振頻率移動 Δf ≈ −(f₀/2k)·∂F/∂z；振幅調變（輕敲）模式維持振幅定值，頻率調變模式用鎖相迴路直接追蹤 Δf。空氣中品質因數 Q 約數百，液體中只有個位數，真空中可達 10⁴ 以上；Q 越高振幅反應越慢，時間常數 τ = Q/(π f₀)，這是真空中必須改用頻率調變的原因。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「共振懸臂的振幅與頻率」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

懸臂以單晶矽或氮化矽經微影與各向異性蝕刻批次製作，探針由矽柱經氧化銳化而成，尖端半徑約 5 到 20 nm。矩形懸臂的彈簧常數 k = E·w·t³/(4L³) 與厚度的三次方成正比，而晶圓厚度控制只有 ±10% 等級，所以同一批懸臂的 k 可相差 30% 以上，必須逐支校正。探針並非理想的點，影像是表面與探針形狀的膨脹（dilation）結果：任何比探針半徑更陡的特徵都會被探針輪廓取代。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「矽懸臂與探針尖端」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

最常見的偏折偵測是光槓桿：雷射聚焦在懸臂背面，反射光打到四象限光電二極體，懸臂末端傾角的變化讓光點在二極體上移動，上下象限的差訊號正比於偏折，左右差訊號則對應扭轉（摩擦力）。幾何放大比由光路長度與懸臂長度決定，可把 1 nm 的偏折變成數百 nm 的光點位移。掃描器方面，現代儀器把 XY 做成帶電容式位置感測器的撓性平台，閉迴路消除壓電遲滯與潛變，Z 軸則維持高頻寬的壓電驅動，並常以獨立感測器記錄真實高度。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「光槓桿與四象限光電二極體」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

力的量測需要兩個校正：光槓桿靈敏度（V 到 nm）與彈簧常數（nm 到 nN）。彈簧常數最常用熱雜訊法：由能量均分定理，懸臂的熱振動均方位移 ⟨z²⟩ 與 k_B·T/k 成正比，量頻譜中第一共振峰的面積即可求 k；光槓桿偵測的是斜率而非位移，加上第一模態只佔總能量的 97%，因此需要 Butt–Jaschke 修正係數 0.817。高度尺度則靠可溯源的台階高度標準片與節距光柵校正，Z 感測器與壓電的非線性要分段記錄。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「熱雜訊頻譜與台階高度標準片」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

AFM 的垂直解析度由三類雜訊決定：懸臂本身的熱布朗運動、光槓桿與光電二極體的散粒與電子雜訊，以及掃描器與環境的機械雜訊。在遠低於共振的頻率，熱雜訊密度為 √(4k_B·T/(k·ω₀·Q))，所以軟而低頻、低 Q 的接觸懸臂最吵；硬而高頻的懸臂熱雜訊可低於 1 fm/√Hz，此時偵測器雜訊（典型 10 到 50 fm/√Hz）反而是主因。輕敲與 FM 模式工作在共振上，熱雜訊被 Q 放大，但訊號也被放大，真正的限制變成頻率或振幅雜訊。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「偏折訊號雜訊底」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

整機性能由機械迴路決定：從探針經懸臂座、掃描器、機架到樣品座的所有零件構成一個結構迴路，溫度變化會讓迴路各段不等膨脹而造成漂移，聲音與地板振動會激發迴路共振。因此 AFM 放在隔音罩與隔振平台上，整機熱平衡後才取像。回授增益需與掃描速度、樣品起伏匹配：增益太低地形被低通濾掉且探針撞上陡坡，太高則回授自激，影像出現高頻條紋；誤差訊號影像是判斷回授是否跟得上的直接證據。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「隔音罩、溫控與回授增益」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

AFM 的驗收把前面的模型變成可重複的測試：可溯源的台階高度與節距光柵驗證 Z 與 XY 尺度，懸臂熱頻譜驗證彈簧常數與雜訊底，尖刺樣品驗證探針半徑，長時間重複成像驗證漂移，硬表面的力曲線驗證靈敏度與線性度。交接紀錄要包含每個掃描範圍的校正係數、感測器雜訊、所用懸臂型號與量得的 k、f₀、Q，以及環境條件，因為任何一項改變都會讓後續量測的不確定度失效。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「驗收標準片與交接紀錄」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
procedureEn: An atomic force microscope needs no conducting sample: a microcantilever carrying a sharp tip approaches the surface and the tip–surface force bends it. At long range van der Waals attraction and electrostatic forces dominate, in contact Pauli repulsion and elastic deformation take over, and in liquid capillary and double-layer forces appear as well. The cantilever converts force to deflection through Hooke's law F = k·Δz, with spring constants from 0.01 N/m for soft levers to 40 N/m for stiff ones, spanning measurable forces from piconewtons to micronewtons. During imaging the feedback holds the deflection (contact mode) or the amplitude or frequency (dynamic modes) constant, and the Z feedback output is the topography. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Cantilever–tip–surface force”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Dynamic modes drive the cantilever near resonance so the tip touches the surface only briefly at the bottom of each cycle or not at all, almost eliminating lateral force. For small amplitudes the force gradient ∂F/∂z modifies the effective spring constant and shifts the resonance by Δf ≈ −(f₀/2k)·∂F/∂z; amplitude-modulation (tapping) mode holds the amplitude constant, while frequency-modulation mode tracks Δf directly with a phase-locked loop. The quality factor Q is a few hundred in air, single digits in liquid and above 10⁴ in vacuum; the higher the Q the slower the amplitude responds, with time constant τ = Q/(π f₀), which is why vacuum work switches to frequency modulation. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Resonant cantilever amplitude and frequency”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Cantilevers are batch-fabricated from single-crystal silicon or silicon nitride by lithography and anisotropic etching, and tips are sharpened from silicon pillars by oxidation to an apex radius of about 5 to 20 nm. A rectangular lever has k = E·w·t³/(4L³), proportional to the cube of thickness, while wafer thickness control is only at the ±10% level, so levers from one batch can differ in k by more than 30% and each must be calibrated. The tip is not an ideal point: the image is the dilation of the surface by the tip shape, and any feature steeper than the tip profile is replaced by the tip's own outline. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Silicon cantilever and tip apex”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The commonest deflection sensor is the optical lever: a laser is focused on the back of the cantilever and the reflected beam lands on a quadrant photodiode, so a change in end slope moves the spot across the diode; the top-minus-bottom difference signal is proportional to deflection and the left-minus-right difference to torsion, hence friction. The geometric gain is set by the optical path length and the lever length and turns a 1 nm deflection into hundreds of nanometres of spot motion. For scanning, modern instruments build the XY stage as a flexure platform with capacitive position sensors whose closed loop removes piezo hysteresis and creep, while Z keeps a high-bandwidth piezo drive and often an independent sensor records true height. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Optical lever and quadrant photodiode”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Force measurement needs two calibrations: the optical-lever sensitivity (volts to nanometres) and the spring constant (nanometres to nanonewtons). The thermal-noise method is the usual route to k: by equipartition the mean-square thermal displacement ⟨z²⟩ of the lever scales as k_B·T/k, so integrating the first resonance peak of the measured spectrum yields k; because the optical lever senses slope rather than displacement and the first mode carries only 97% of the energy, the Butt–Jaschke correction factor 0.817 is applied. The height scale is calibrated with traceable step-height standards and pitch gratings, and the nonlinearity of the Z sensor and piezo is recorded range by range. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Thermal spectrum and step-height standard”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Vertical resolution is set by three noise classes: the lever's own thermal Brownian motion, shot and electronic noise of the optical lever and photodiode, and mechanical noise from the scanner and environment. Well below resonance the thermal noise density is √(4k_B·T/(k·ω₀·Q)), so soft, low-frequency, low-Q contact levers are the noisiest; stiff high-frequency levers fall below 1 fm/√Hz and the detector noise, typically 10 to 50 fm/√Hz, dominates instead. Tapping and FM modes operate on resonance where thermal noise is amplified by Q, but so is the signal, and the true limit becomes frequency or amplitude noise. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Deflection-signal noise floor”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Whole-instrument performance is set by the mechanical loop: every part from tip through lever holder, scanner and frame to sample holder forms a structural loop, temperature changes expand its segments unequally and cause drift, and sound or floor vibration excites its resonances. The AFM therefore sits under an acoustic hood on an isolation platform and images only after thermal equilibrium. Feedback gains must match scan speed and surface relief: too little gain low-pass filters the topography and the tip collides with steep slopes, too much gain makes the loop oscillate with high-frequency stripes, and the error-signal image is the direct evidence of whether feedback keeps up. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Acoustic hood, temperature control and feedback gains”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

AFM acceptance turns the earlier models into repeatable tests: traceable step heights and pitch gratings verify the Z and XY scales, the lever's thermal spectrum verifies spring constant and noise floor, a spike sample verifies tip radius, long repeated imaging verifies drift, and force curves on a hard surface verify sensitivity and linearity. The handoff record must contain calibration factors for each scan range, sensor noise, the lever type with its measured k, f₀ and Q, and the environmental conditions, because a change in any of them invalidates the uncertainty of later measurements. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Acceptance standards and handoff record”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

pitfalls: 設定力過大會讓探針在軟樣品上犁出溝槽或把生物分子推走，影像看起來平整卻是被壓平後的假象；在空氣中忽略毛細力，則實際作用力比設定值高出數 nN，探針磨損加快、解析度隨時間變差。
把廠商標示的 k 直接拿來算力，誤差可達 ±50%，彈性模數結果相差一倍；若熱法頻譜中混入 50 Hz 諧波或聲學尖峰而未排除，擬合面積被高估，k 被低估，所有力值跟著縮小。
pitfallsEn: An excessive set-point force ploughs grooves into soft samples or sweeps biomolecules away, so the image looks smooth only because the surface has been flattened; ignoring capillary force in air means the real load exceeds the set point by several nanonewtons, accelerating tip wear so resolution degrades over time.

Using the vendor's nominal k for force calculations can err by ±50% and double or halve modulus results; if mains harmonics or acoustic peaks contaminate the thermal spectrum and are not excluded, the fitted area is overestimated, k is underestimated and every force value shrinks with it.

related.title: 掃描穿隧顯微鏡
related.transfer: 可遷移「探針作用力與懸臂力感測」與「彈簧常數與高度尺度的校正」的建模、量測與誤差預算方法；掃描穿隧顯微鏡的元件、尺度與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The modelling, measurement and error-budget methods of "Tip–surface forces and cantilever force sensing" and "Calibrating spring constant and height scale" transfer, while components, scales and acceptance conditions of Scanning tunneling microscopes must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦懸臂力感測、光槓桿偵測、動態模式、彈簧常數校正與皮米級雜訊預算；掃描穿隧顯微鏡則以穿隧電流指數律、壓電掃描、隔振與雜訊預算的原子級量測工程為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on cantilever force sensing, optical-lever detection, dynamic modes, spring-constant calibration and picometre noise budgets; Scanning tunneling microscopes centres on tunneling exponential law, piezo scanning, vibration isolation and noise budgets for atomic-scale metrology, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「懸臂—探針—表面作用力」與「探針—樣品穿隧接面」的輸入、輸出與主要干擾。
把本課算例的一個假設移到掃描穿隧顯微鏡，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「電流雜訊預算與等效間隙雜訊」為例，設計一項能區分兩種系統的驗證量測，並註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “Cantilever–tip–surface force” and “Tip–sample tunneling junction”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Scanning tunneling microscopes, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Current-noise budget and equivalent gap noise", design a verification measurement that distinguishes the two systems and state its uncertainty.

related.title: 白光干涉表面輪廓儀
related.transfer: 可遷移「探針作用力與懸臂力感測」與「彈簧常數與高度尺度的校正」的建模、量測與誤差預算方法；白光干涉表面輪廓儀的元件、尺度與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The modelling, measurement and error-budget methods of "Tip–surface forces and cantilever force sensing" and "Calibrating spring constant and height scale" transfer, while components, scales and acceptance conditions of White-light interferometric profilometers must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦懸臂力感測、光槓桿偵測、動態模式、彈簧常數校正與皮米級雜訊預算；白光干涉表面輪廓儀則以低相干包絡定位、Mirau 干涉物鏡、垂直掃描與 ISO 25178 計量特性校正為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on cantilever force sensing, optical-lever detection, dynamic modes, spring-constant calibration and picometre noise budgets; White-light interferometric profilometers centres on low-coherence envelope localisation, Mirau interference objectives, vertical scanning and ISO 25178 metrological-characteristic calibration, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「懸臂—探針—表面作用力」與「寬頻光源與零光程差包絡」的輸入、輸出與主要干擾。
把本課算例的一個假設移到白光干涉表面輪廓儀，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「蝙蝠翼、異材相位與薄膜干擾」為例，設計一項能區分兩種系統的驗證量測，並註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “Cantilever–tip–surface force” and “Broadband source and zero-OPD envelope”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to White-light interferometric profilometers, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Batwing artefacts, dissimilar-material phase and thin-film interference", design a verification measurement that distinguishes the two systems and state its uncertainty.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 原子力顯微鏡
history.text: 1986 年 Gerd Binnig、Calvin Quate 與 Christoph Gerber 發表第一台原子力顯微鏡，用 STM 探針讀取金箔懸臂的偏折；1988 年起光槓桿偵測取代穿隧偵測，1989 年 Digital Instruments 推出商用 AFM，1993 年輕敲模式讓軟材料與生物樣品成像成為常規，1995 年 Giessibl 以頻率調變在真空中達到 Si(111)-7×7 的原子解析度。今日 AFM 已是半導體線上量測、材料力學與生物物理的標準工具。本課只重建公開的物理與工程邏輯。
history.textEn: In 1986 Gerd Binnig, Calvin Quate and Christoph Gerber published the first atomic force microscope, reading the deflection of a gold-foil lever with an STM tip; optical-lever detection replaced tunneling detection from 1988, Digital Instruments shipped a commercial AFM in 1989, tapping mode made soft materials and biological samples routine from 1993, and in 1995 Giessibl reached atomic resolution on Si(111)-7×7 in vacuum with frequency modulation. The AFM is now a standard tool for in-line semiconductor metrology, materials mechanics and biophysics. This course reconstructs only public physics and engineering logic.

history.title: 從工程史到可驗證模型
history.titleEn: From engineering history to verifiable models
history.text: 本課把「探針作用力與懸臂力感測」到「標準樣品驗收與工程交接」改寫為 32 個原創分析、量測與診斷任務；不複製來源圖片、影片逐字稿或現場程序。
history.textEn: The course turns "Tip–surface forces and cantilever force sensing" through "Reference-sample acceptance and engineering handoff" into 32 original analysis, measurement and diagnosis tasks without copying source images, video transcripts or field procedures.
